body: We added the TXT record for domain verification 48 hours ago but the status still says pending, so we can't enforce SSO.

subject: API token creation disabled
body: The 'Create token' button is greyed out for our workspace admins. We need a token to set up our integration this week.

body: We imported 12k contacts and only about 6k are visible now; some contacts that were not in the CSV were deleted too. Sales uses this data daily.

subject: Scheduled reports not sent
body: None of our scheduled reports were delivered this morning, and nothing shows in the error log. Second time this week.

subject: Search results out of date
body: Search doesn't find records created in the last 3 hours. Older records are found fine.

subject: File uploads fail intermittently
body: About 1 in 5 file uploads fails with 'Network error'. Retrying usually works.

subject: Exports stuck in 'processing'
body: Every CSV export since yesterday stays at 'processing' forever. We need the data for a board meeting on Friday.

body: Since this morning's release, values in our 'Contract value' custom field are being overwritten with zeros when anyone edits a record. This is spreading across thousands of records right now.

subject: Dashboard charts not loading
body: Charts on the analytics dashboard show a spinner forever. Tables load fine.

body: No automation rules have fired since 02:00 UTC. Hundreds of customer follow-ups and SLA escalations are not being created for any of our teams.

subject: Occasional 504 on large reports
body: Reports covering more than 12 months sometimes time out with a 504. Shorter ranges work.

subject: Deleted project still visible

subject: Page load slow in Australia

subject: Slack notifications stopped

subject: GraphQL endpoint timeout
body: Nested GraphQL queries over 3 levels deep time out after 30 s.

body: Each ticket escalated to Jira creates two Jira issues.
